review_candidates.title: Supply Chain Advisor - West Africa
review_candidates.description: Role purpose As Supply Chain Advisor, you will be a key member of the HELP Logistics project delivery team and report to the Regional Director. Your primary focus will be on managing comprehensive consulting projects that deliver analytical solutions to complex supply chain problems in the humanitarian and development space. In close collaboration with HELP's partner organizations, you will lead the identification of critical supply chain problems and frame and implement projects using robust analytical methods. West and Central Africa is HELP's most francophone and most corridor-dependent region. A substantial part of your work will advance the localization of humanitarian supply chains, strengthening the systems and capabilities of national and local organizations so that improvements are owned and sustained locally. To strengthen HELP Logistics' footprint and impact in the region, you will support the Regional Director in maintaining existing partnerships and identifying potential new partnership opportunities across sectors, within the scope and direction set by the Regional Director. What you'll do Functional Accountability  Lead technical workstreams within projects  Convert analysis into practical recommendations and tools  Ensure workstream outputs are fit for partner decision-making  Maintain technical quality and usability of deliverables  Assure the integrity, accuracy, and confidentiality of partner and project data used in analysis and deliverables  Document methods, sources, and assumptions so that every analysis is transparent and reproducible by someone else  Escalate significant risks to the Regional Director Operational Scope  Liaise with partner organizations to understand their needs and identify areas for improvement  Identify adequate solutions and support the implementation process while coordinating with the project team and various stakeholders  Apply your supply chain expertise to frame comprehensive projects and design technical approaches  Select appropriate frameworks and methods for tasks  Apply structured analysis and modeling to complex problems  Support national and local organizations to strengthen their own supply chain systems, in line with HELP's localization agenda for West and Central Africa  Ensure on-time delivery of project deliverables and monitor project budget  Support the Regional Director in structuring project work plans  Identify opportunities for collaboration and support the Regional Director in project and partner acquisition efforts in the region Capacity Strengthening & Knowledge Transfer  Deliver and facilitate capacity-strengthening activities (trainings, workshops) for partner organizations, and transfer tools, templates, and methods to build lasting partner ownership  Mentor and provide on-the-job guidance to Analysts and junior colleagues within assigned workstreams Tools, Systems, and Resources  Build dashboards, analytical models, and calculators for projects  Test tools with the partner staff who will use them, and refine them on what they tell you  Contribute to organization-wide technical toolkits  Support updates to methods, templates and instructions  Capture lessons learned from each engagement so that the region's methods and templates improve Decision Rights Decides: Choice of analytical methods, frameworks, and tools used within assigned workstreams; day-to-day prioritization of workstream tasks; content and structure of recommendations and technical deliverables before internal review.  Escalates: Changes to project scope, budget, or timeline; new partnership commitments or agreements; risks with reputational, financial, or safeguarding implications; decisions affecting other workstreams or regions. Your profile Qualification Requirements  Master’s degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering, operations strategy, or a related field 4-6 years in supply chain consulting, operations or technical advisory roles  Demonstrated ability to lead analytical assessments  Strong project planning, management, communication and coordination skills (with technical staff as well as senior management)  Proven ability to analyze, diagnose and solve (supply chain) problems at operational, tactical and strategic level  Familiar with political, cultural and economic situation in the West and Central Africa region Knowledge of customs and trade standards and practical exposure to import/export/transit processes across West and Central Africa  Strong data processing skills including advanced use of Microsoft Excel and familiarity with Tableau or Power BI.  Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize data and evidence, compare patterns across contexts, and translate findings into clear communication towards humanitarian, government, commercial and donor stakeholders. A collaborative and candid working style, evidenced by raising problems early, changing your own position when the evidence changes, and delivering without close supervision in a small team  Fluency in English & French  Preferred  Existing relationships with regional (local) and international NGOs, UN agencies, or development partners in West and Central Africa  Demonstrated experience building technical capability in supply chain-related areas  Experience supporting the localization or nationalization of supply chain functions with national or local organizations  Track record of raising technical standards in advisory or consulting environments • Client-facing advisory experience in supply chain management Why us? Company Profile  Our purpose is to shape supply chains to benefit humanity. HELP Logistics is a not-for-profit subsidiary of the Kühne Foundation, dedicated to supply chain and logistics. We work across commercial practice, academic research, and humanitarian operations, applying what works in one to solve problems in another. We partner with donors, UN agencies, the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, local organizations, and universities to improve supply chain performance in demanding operating environments. We transfer knowledge so those improvements outlast our involvement. We have six offices in Switzerland, Singapore, Jordan, Kenya, Senegal, and Germany. Our Values  Collaboration: Promote a culture of open communication and teamwork, ensuring efficient sharing of knowledge and resources while supporting individual well-being. Curiosity: Encourage continuous learning and questioning the status quo to drive transformative solutions that address real-world challenges. Integrity: Commit to the highest ethical standards in our operations and interactions, ensuring data-driven, transparent and accountable decisions. Resilience: Adapt to change, learn from challenges, and provide support to pursue our goals persistently. Safeguarding and Conduct HELP Logistics has zero tolerance for sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment, fraud, and any conduct inconsistent with our Code of Conduct. All staff are expected to uphold these standards in every interaction with colleagues, partners, and the communities we serve, and to report any concerns through the appropriate channels.  Working arrangements This role is based in Dakar, Senegal. Some remote work is permitted. Travel within West and Central Africa is expected up to 50% of working time to support project delivery, partner engagements, and field activities. Occasional travel to other HELP regions may be required for cross-regional collaboration or technical support. This is a 2 years fixed contract position. How to apply  Send your CV and a cover letter of no more than one page with the subject line Supply Chain Advisor (P3) - West Africa. Your cover letter should describe one supply chain problem you diagnosed and what changed as a result. Include three professional references.  Deadline: 16 October 2026 Start date: 4 January 2027

review_candidates.description: Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities. GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 33 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.35 bn.in 2023. There are no limits to where you can take your career. The vacancy We are looking to expand the Manufacturing Engineering team at Fokker Landing Gear, located in Papendrecht, and for this reason, we are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer for the Product & Planning team. As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer Product & Planning at multi-technology manufacturing campus in Papendrecht, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficient and seamless production of landing gear components. Your contributions will directly support the delivery of unique projects that prioritize the safety of everyone who relies on our products in flight. In this role, you will be a key member of an Integrated Product Team (IPT), supporting operational deliveries by preparing and managing product-related documentation. This includes analyzing production characteristics to improve processes, managing Level 1 (L1) non-conformities, and defining temporary production instructions. Additionally, you will prepare dispositions for Level 2 (L2) non-conformities, with the aim of advancing to a position as a Non-Conformity (NC) approver. Fokker Landing Gear Fokker Landing Gear, part of GKN Fokker, is a recognized specialist in landing gear and related systems. We focus on the design and development, production and assembly of complete landing gears, as well as the repair and reassembly of systems already in use. In doing so, we work on the most famous aircraft and helicopters; think of the Apache combat helicopter, the F-35 Lightning II (JSF), the Bombardier Dash 8 Q400 and the multipurpose NH90 maritime combat helicopter. What You'll Do Develop technical solutions to complex problems by exemplifying a safety-first mind-set and ensuring compliance with the GKN Aerospace Health, Safety and Environmental policies and standards. Hold responsibility for the technical support of manufacturing development and integration for production. Resolve issues pertaining to vendor schedule and/or quality. Utilize root cause analysis, preventative and corrective action to reduce/eliminate non-conformances. Manage the implementation of tooling and or production planning, from original concept through to production; Design these processes with a high degree of process capability utilizing the GKN standard Zero Defect Manufacturing (ZDM) tool suite to demonstrate as such. Oversee the product development, first article development, configuration changes, build process definition and implementation; Deliver measurable, metrics driven results in line with Operational & Program goals. Maintain positive, team relationships with internal and external customers, as well as co-workers. Continuously improve production processes by implementing Lean initiatives. What You'll Bring Experience in managing (new) Product / Process introduction (industrialization) & existing production process improvements. 10+ years' experience in Manufacturing Engineering. Degree in a related Engineering discipline, such as Aerospace, Mechanical, Automotive. Ability to influence people, build trust and establish effective working relationship within a global organization. Working knowledge of LEAN processes and practices. Working knowledge of quality system models such as ISO9000, AS9100, or D1-9000. Quality driven and strong documentation / reporting skills. Working knowledge of machining processes (milling, mill-turn, boring, honing) and of surface treatment processes (heat treatment, plating, shot-peen, NDI) would be an advantage. Fluency in English, both in writing & speaking. What We'll Offer A challenging position in an innovative and international environment with a rich history in aircraft manufacturing. Our organization breathes passion for engineering and all our teams are justifiably proud of what they develop and build. As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you will receive a fantastic range of benefits, including: A competitive compensation package, with salary determined based on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. 42 paid holidays for full-time employment (29 holidays and 13 permanent ADV days). Working conditions according to the CAO Metalektro, including an excellent pension scheme and travel allowance. A working environment, in which we work together to achieve the best result for our customers. Every opportunity to build on your career and personal development. Extra info Apply online by sending us your CV. Due to data privacy reasons we do not handle any applications sent by email. For additional questions you can contact Glenn Duggert, Talent Acquisition, via glenn.duggert@fokker.com. Part of the selection procedure is carrying out the necessary checks and screenings in order to meet the requirements set by GKN Fokker's customers, partners and suppliers within the program. The checks and screenings will be assessed on the basis of frameworks set by our Export Compliance & Security department. Every employee within GKN Fokker must ultimately be authorized to give substance to his or her position. Assessment of checks and screenings can lead to the fact that no content can be given to the position and therefore no employment or deployment can follow. The onboarding at Fokker usually takes 3-4 weeks. We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go? A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work. We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know. We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology.

Analyse sell-out results, incremental sales, customer and channel performance, shopper behaviour, competitor activities, retail execution quality and ROI, translating insights into clear recommendations and corrective actions. Prepare trade marketing inputs for the development of existing markets and entry into new markets, and lead the relevant trade marketing activities once initiatives are approved. Develop regional tools, briefs, guidelines, checklists and reporting models, provide functional support to local Trade Marketing teams and promote the exchange of successful practices across the region. If you know how to connect category strategy, shopper understanding and disciplined retail execution to achieve measurable sell-out growth, we would be pleased to hear from you. Apply now if you are ready to take ownership of an exciting product category and contribute to the further growth of the Hisense brand in Serbia and BIH. We look forward to meeting you!

review_candidates.title: Reception / Front Desk & AI Builder
review_candidates.description: Why this role matters This is the future of reception and office administration, and we are hiring the person who will build it. You will run our front desk and lead the build of a new operating system for our reception and office administration, where AI connects, manages and automates our systems, orchestrated by you. What you will build Office information reaches us by email, phone, paper and visit, and it lives in separate places: inboxes, calendars, spreadsheets, shared drives and filing cabinets. Today a person reads each item, records it and passes it on by hand. You will connect these systems into one operating system for the office. AI will read what comes in, record it, route it to the right person and follow it up. You will set the rules, handle the exceptions and check everything that leaves the office. Build apps and AI assistants for the front desk, such as visitor check-in, a call log, meeting room booking and a correspondence register that updates itself from scanned and emailed letters. Connect the tools we already use, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Sheets and our CRM, so that information entered once reaches every place it is needed. Automate recurring work: every receipt and invoice read, logged and filed; renewal reminders for insurance, registrations and licences; supplies reordered before they run out; and monthly reports built from live data. Design, build and test each system with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code and app builders, starting with one workflow and improving it every week. Write an SOP for every system you build, with a clear owner and a human check, so that anyone in the office can run it. Measure the hours saved and the errors caught, and report progress to management each month. How you will orchestrate it Map every office workflow with management and rank each one by the time and errors AI can remove. Decide which steps AI runs on its own, which need your approval and which stay with people. Monitor the systems each day, fix what breaks and keep a log of every change. Train colleagues on each new tool and use their feedback to improve it. Protect confidential contracts and claims information in every tool you connect. The operations you will run You will run these operations from your first day, and each one is a candidate for the systems you build. Front desk and office administration Welcome visitors, answer and route calls, and keep the company contact list current. Run the digital and physical filing system, including reference numbers, business cards and archiving. Keep the incoming and outgoing correspondence register. Manage travel and accommodation bookings, office consumables, stationery and supplies. Work with IT support on account creation, access and closure for departing employees. Keep office insurance and registrations for vehicles, buildings and equipment up to date. Financial coordination Support invoicing, receipts and payment processing. Prepare purchase orders, follow up on overdue payments and reconcile creditor statements. Manage petty cash transactions. Track rent collection, municipality taxes, electricity and water expenditures. Maintain financial logs and recurring reports. Management support Proofread and format letters and contracts, drafting first versions with AI and checking each one before it goes out. Assist with visa applications and client correspondence. Maintain calendars, set appointments and support executive travel. Ensure official documents and licences are up to date. Who we are looking for You have built something that people use: an app, a website, an automation or an internal tool. You use AI tools every day, learn new ones quickly and are comfortable connecting systems through integrations, APIs or no-code platforms. You are organised, calm with visitors and callers, and careful with detail. You write and speak clearly in Arabic and English. You handle confidential information with discretion. How to apply Our interview process has four stages: 1. An online interview with our AI interviewer 2. Building a simple app with AI that solves a real office administration problem 3. An online interview with a member of our team 4. A final interview at our office If you pass a stage, you move on to the next one. To apply, send your CV to careers@cmajo.com, with the subject "AI Front Desk".
